column2: Since your birth, a ravenous hunger has filled your mind and cramped your belly. As you are growing, this unending urge seems to be growing even further, regardless of how much you eat.
Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] seems to be growing to be quite the plump ogre.
Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] is eating less than expected. If [From.GetSheHe] continues like this, [From.GetSheHe]'ll be a laughing stock for the tribe.

Your [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has not taken well to your resistance to hunger. After a good beating, [From.GetSheHe] has started to force you to take your daily portion of meat and then some.
You've had a good childhood, taking always as much food as you could and now it well shows, as you are one of the largest ogres of your tribe, tough and intimidating.

You might have had some hits and misses during your childhood, but you've certainly tried your best taking as much food as you could. If nothing else, you've certainly grown to be an ogre of a respectable size.
You didn't care much for appeasing your own hunger, letting other children of the tribe take the best meat and now it shows. Many in the tribe push you around and laugh at your weak constitution.
Ogre Chieftains are respected for the girth of their belly. As you are of a relatively weak constitution, many of your warriors have come to believe you not to be the better choice for a leader.
